name: John
summary: A fisherman, the son of Zebedee and brother of James, who became one of the twelve apostles. After Jesus rose, he and Peter healed a lame man and spoke boldly before the council.

key_moments.title: Leaving the Nets
key_moments.description: Jesus saw James and John in their boat mending their nets and called them. They left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants and followed Jesus.

key_moments.title: Sees Jesus Changed on the Mountain
key_moments.description: Jesus took Peter, John and James up a mountain to pray. As He prayed His face changed and His clothes shone, and Moses and Elijah talked with Him.

key_moments.title: Sees a Lame Man Healed at the Gate
key_moments.description: Peter and John met a man lame from birth at the temple gate called Beautiful. Peter healed him in Jesus' name, and the man held on to them as the people ran together in wonder.

key_moments.title: Refuses to Stop Speaking of Jesus
key_moments.description: The rulers marvelled at the boldness of Peter and John, though they were unlearned men. Told to stop speaking about Jesus, they answered that they could not stop telling what they had seen and heard.
